'''Ame Llom''' was an [[Near-Human]] [[Ame Llom's species|alien]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Coruscanti/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] who frequented the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] during the last [[Local year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she visited the [[Nightclub/Legends|club]] and laughed with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] companion while the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|hid]] among other patrons from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Biography==
Ame Llom, a [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="DB" /> member of a [[Near-Human]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Ame Llom's species|species]],<ref name="Who'sWho" /> was a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Coruscanti/Legends|of]]<ref name="DB" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. On her homeworld, she frequented the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="DB" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the planet's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]],<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> during the last few [[Local year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="DB" />

On a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="aotc" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Llom visited the club when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] escaped after her [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and disguised herself as another club visitor. While the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was searching for Wesell, ordered a [[Foodstuff/Legends|drink]] at the bar, Llom walked by with a drink of her own behind her [[Human/Legends|Human]] companion. She rejoined the companion and laughed with them when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Kenobi's Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], passed by them. Shortly after, Llom again walked near the bar behind the Human,<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> and just moments later, Wesell was disarmed by Kenobi at the bar.<ref name="aotc" />

==Personality and traits==
Llom, a frequent visitor of the<ref name="DB" /> popular<ref name="OC">{{DB|location|outlandersclub|Outlander Club}}</ref> Outlander Club,<ref name="DB" /> had [[Color/Legends|blue-green]] skin,<ref name="Who'sWho" /> brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="DB" /> 

==Equipment==
While at the club,<ref name="aotc" /> Llom wore a beaded decoration on her forehead,<ref name="DB" /> a dark hooded [[Clothing/Legends|top]] that showed her midriff,<ref name="aotc" /> and a dark skirt.<ref name="Good">{{SW|url=video/good-to-g-o|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 10: Good to G.O.}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|With her blue-green skin, Ame Llom is a near-human alien of a species not yet described in the Expanded Universe.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Who'sWho" />}}
[[File:Ame.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The extra playing Ame Llom introduced the fourth episode of ''on location''.]]
Ame Llom first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="aotc" /> which released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The Outlander Club scenes including Llom, who was portrayed by uncredited extra,<ref name="aotc" /> were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The character was first revealed when the extra playing Llom, in costume, introduced the fourth episode of the Episode II behind-the-scenes video series [[On location|''on location'']].<ref name="On location">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/4.html|series=On Location|text=Part 4 - The Man Behind C-3PO}}</ref> The episode, titled "The Man Behind C-3PO," was released on [[August 22]], 2000.<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/archive.html|text=''on location'' archive}}</ref>  

Llom was first identified<ref name="Who'sWho" /> in the [[April 6]], [[2004]]<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]", written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine. "Ame Llom" is a [[Tuckerization|backwards rearrangement]] of "Mollema," the maiden name of [[Lucas Licensing]] employee [[Stacy Cheregotis|Stacy Chergotis]]. Wallace also states the character [[Sne Wo]] can be seen talking to Llom in the film, despite the character not doing so.<ref name="Who'sWho" />
